gloss.en: Departing from an accepted standard, normal course or natural type; atypical
gloss.zh-Hans: 偏离公认标准、正常路径或通常类型的；反常的、异常的

meaning.en: Aberrant is primarily an adjective, not the ordinary noun for an error. Chinese 讹 is a semantic neighbour and sound candidate, not the primary translation.
meaning.zh-Hans: aberrant 主要是形容词，并非普通名词“错误”。汉语“讹”是语义邻近项和声音候选，不是主要翻译。

rationale.en: Dictionary meaning and part of speech support 反常的／偏离常规的. The separate err ↔ 讹 comparison remains a candidate hypothesis.
rationale.zh-Hans: 词典义与词性支持“反常的／偏离常规的”；err ↔ 讹的比较另列为候选假说。

summary.en: English aberrant comes from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, the present participle of aberrare: ab- ‘away, from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, be mistaken’. French aberrant/aberrante is the adjectivized present participle of French aberrer, itself borrowed from Latin aberrare; it is not evidenced here as an English loan. French erreur continues Latin error, erroris.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 来自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词：ab-“离开、从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”。法语 aberrant／aberrante 是法语 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词，而 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare；没有证据支持它从英语借入。法语 erreur 承自拉丁语 error、erroris。

claim.en: English aberrant is chiefly an adjective borrowed from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, present participle of aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 主要是形容词，借自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词。

claim.en: Latin aberrare is morphologically ab- ‘away/from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, err’; the b belongs to the inherited prefix ab-.
claim.zh-Hans: 拉丁语 aberrare 的形态是 ab-“离开／从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”；b 属于继承的前缀 ab-。

claim.en: French aberrant/aberrante is an adjectivized present participle of aberrer; French aberrer was borrowed from Latin aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 aberrant／aberrante 是 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词；法语 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare。

claim.en: English err is a verb from Middle English erren, borrowed from Anglo-French and Latin errare; French erreur is a feminine noun from Latin error, erroris.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 是动词，来自中古英语 erren，经盎格鲁-法语和拉丁语 errare；法语 erreur 是阴性名词，来自拉丁语 error、erroris。

summary.en: English err and Mandarin 讹 é occupy a related error/deviation semantic field and may sound loosely similar. Their actual pronunciations are not identical: English has an r-coloured or vowel-plus-/r/ form depending on accent, while Mandarin é /ɤ˧˥/ is non-rhotic and bears lexical tone. No regular correspondence or common origin is claimed.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 err 与普通话“讹”é 同处错误／偏离语义场，也可能产生宽泛音近感。但实际发音并不相同：英语依口音具有卷舌色彩或元音加 /r/，普通话 é /ɤ˧˥/ 不卷舌且带词汇声调。这里不主张规律音变或共同来源。

claim.en: err ↔ 讹 é is a modern-form phonetic-semantic candidate: both can concern mistake/error, but sound overlap is partial and accent-dependent.
claim.zh-Hans: err ↔ 讹 é 是现代词形的语音—语义候选：两者都可涉及错误，但声音重合仅属部分且受英语口音影响。

summary.en: The historically attested motion image ‘wander away’ supports a cognitive path DEPARTURE → DEVIATION → ERROR/ABNORMALITY. This explains a shared semantic neighbourhood, not a Chinese–European etymological relation.
summary.zh-Hans: 历史可证的运动意象“游荡离开”支持 DEPARTURE → DEVIATION → ERROR／ABNORMALITY 的认知路径。这解释共享语义邻域，不证明汉语与欧洲语言的词源关系。

summary.en: The proposed idea that b was inserted merely to connect initial a to err is rejected as a historical explanation: b is part of Latin ab-. The observation is preserved as an author sound-structure hypothesis, not deleted.
summary.zh-Hans: “b 只是为连接开头 a 与 err 而加入”的想法，作为历史解释被否定：b 属于拉丁前缀 ab-。这一观察仍作为作者的声音结构假说保留，而非删除。

claim.en: Author hypothesis: b may have been inserted between a and err as a consonantal bridge.
claim.zh-Hans: 作者假说：b 可能作为辅音桥梁插入 a 与 err 之间。

claim.en: English err /er, ɜːr/ and Mandarin 讹 é /ɤ˧˥/ share an onsetless vowel-centred impression for some listeners and overlap semantically around error.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err /er, ɜːr/ 与普通话“讹”é /ɤ˧˥/ 对部分听者有以元音为中心的近似听感，语义又都涉及错误。

limitations.en: English rhoticity, vowel quality and Mandarin lexical tone differ; ‘same sound’ overstates the comparison.
limitations.zh-Hans: 英语卷舌性、元音音质与普通话词汇声调均不同；称为“同音”会夸大比较。

claim.en: English err and Mandarin 讹 é may form a memorable modern sound-meaning association in the ERROR/DEVIATION field, without common-origin claim.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 与普通话“讹”é 可能在 ERROR／DEVIATION 语义场形成可记忆的现代声音—意义联想，但不主张共同来源。

supporting_cases: err /er, ɜːr/: make a mistake; stray

testability.en: Test blinded sound-similarity and semantic-relatedness separately, with unrelated onsetless-vowel controls and multiple English accents.
testability.zh-Hans: 分别盲测声音相似度与语义相关度，加入无关零声母元音负对照，并覆盖多种英语口音。

claim.en: The b in aberrant was added as a consonantal bridge between a and err.
claim.zh-Hans: aberrant 中的 b 是在 a 与 err 之间加入的辅音桥。

supporting_cases: surface segmentation a.b.err.ant in the author note
counterexamples: French aberrer independently continues Latin aberrare

testability.en: Historical morphology is already testable against attested Latin forms and dictionary etymologies; those sources contradict the insertion account.
testability.zh-Hans: 历史形态可直接用有文献的拉丁语形式与词源词典检验；这些来源与插入说相矛盾。

proposition.en: When it is aberrant, is it beautiful like a swan, or a mis-sounded cry of a domestic goose? No—that love is full of beauty and art.
proposition.zh-Hans: 错讹的时候，是一种如天鹅般的美，还是家鹅的一声讹音？不——那爱里，仍充满美与艺。

translations.text: When it is aberrant, is it beautiful like a swan, or a mis-sounded cry of a domestic goose? No—that love is full of beauty and art.

evidence_boundary.en: The swan/domestic-goose, mis-sound, love, beauty and art wordplay is literature. It does not support the historical morphology or the err ↔ 讹 hypothesis.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 天鹅／家鹅、讹音、爱、美与艺的文字游戏属于文学，不为历史形态或 err ↔ 讹假说提供证据。

editorial_notes.en: Aberrant and err remain distinct: aberrant is chiefly an adjective; err is a verb. They are connected through the Latin errare family.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: aberrant 与 err 保持区分：aberrant 主要是形容词，err 是动词；两者通过拉丁语 errare 词族相连。

editorial_notes.en: The ordinary lexical mapping is reviewed; the err ↔ 讹 sound-meaning observation remains Candidate. Publication or literary review does not prove that candidate.
editorial_notes.zh-Hans: 普通词义对应已核验；err ↔ 讹的声音—意义观察仍为 Candidate。词条发表或文学审核都不证明该候选成立。

source.author: Jinkai Liu
source.normalization: Parts of speech, French accents and punctuation normalized in the reviewed fields; the original research claims and literary text remain quoted here.
source.raw_note: 英语：aberrant n. 错误；a.b.err.ant；这里也许是 err 前面与元音 a 相连需要加一个辅音。err n. 错误。法语：aberrant a. 荒谬；a.b.err.ant；这个词从英语而来；aberrant (masculine)，aberrante (feminine)；erreur n. 错误。汉语：讹【e】n. 谣言，错误。备注：这里 aberrant，是 err 前面与元音 a 相连需要加一个辅音。诗文：错讹的时候，是一种如天鹅般美丽还是家鹅的讹音？不，那爱充满美艺。When it is aberrant, is it a kind of beautiful like a swan or a mispronunciation of a goose? No, that love is full of beauty and art.
